calls.title: Ashley/Michael
calls.summary: During the meeting, the team assessed current product analytics data, noting 1.5 million events recorded last month, primarily from cloud users since late October, and identified limitations in historical analysis. They reported that 3,600 organizations had viewed at least one app, emphasizing the need for cohort definitions to enhance tracking of user retention over time. Feature flag metrics revealed 20 billion fetch requests this month, with actual evaluations potentially reaching 200 billion, indicating extensive platform usage. A dashboard titled 'Ashley Usage Data' was created for ongoing analysis. The participants also discussed data limitations stemming from incomplete records and vague user activity definitions, suggesting cross-team discussions for improvements. Lastly, cloud data environments were noted to slow down operations, while collaboration was deemed vital for refining data insights.
